root.label: Israel opens first national pavilion at Marrakesh Air Show

events.label: Israel opens first national pavilion at Marrakesh Air Show

slots.name: exhibiting companies
slots.sentence: The ministry said eight Israeli defence companies exhibited “advanced, combat-proven technologies at the show” in Marrakesh, which runs until Saturday.

slots.name: major industries exhibiting
slots.sentence: “Israel’s three major defence industries, Elbit Systems, IAI, and Rafael, also exhibited, presenting solutions across the air, land, sea, space, intelligence, cyber, and digital domains,” it said.

slots.name: frequency
slots.sentence: The Marrakech Air Show, taking place from October 7 to October 10 this year at the Marrakech Royal Moroccan Air Force Base, is organised every two years and is meant for civil and military aeronautics and space industries to highlight their latest offerings.
